clips.send: Monmouth. Jun 28, 1778. A long, hot battle in 100 degrees Fahrenheit (38 degrees Celsius ) heat; neither side wins clearly.

clips.send: Trenton. Dec 26, 1776. On Christmas night Washington crosses the icy Delaware River and surprises about 1,500 Hessian soldiers; about 900 are captured.

clips.send: Battle of Long Island. Aug 27, 1776. The largest battle of the war: the British crush Washington’s army, which escapes across the East River by night in fog.

clips.send: Siege of Boston ends. Mar 17, 1776. Henry Knox drags 59 cannons about 300 miles from Fort Ticonderoga. Facing them, the British sail away.
